name: frontier
about: The best measured model for each role (November 2026). Every role is on Claude Code: the benchmarks put Anthropic first for all four today.

why.research: Opus 5.5: best single model in a stock CLI on SWE-Atlas-QnA (65.9), the codebase-question benchmark.
why.plan: Fable 5.2: first on FrontierCode 2.0 (changes mergeable with no human edits, out-of-scope edits penalised); planning spends few tokens, so its price matters little.
why.code: Opus 5.5: joint first on Terminal-Bench 4.1 (65.8%) at about 29% of Fable 5.2's cost; best value in SlopCodeBench's top ten ($0.99 a checkpoint).
why.verify: Opus 5.5 at xhigh: long browser sessions reward care; no benchmark measures this directly.
